inputs.text: [curious] ee… LAZ… moh… SOR… us. In Greek, "elasmo" means a thin metal plate. [serious] His shoulder bones were flat, like little plates, [confident] so that's what scientists named him.
[happily] Close. The thin-plated lizard. He lived eighty million years ago, [amazed] in a huge sea that cut [serious] North America right in half.
[gasps] A sea in the middle of the land?
[confident] Exactly. That whole region was underwater, back then.
